name: Marcus
primary_objection: We need to think about it.
trust_unlock: Ask what his absent spouse needs to feel comfortable and when both can review the design.
spouse_status: Spouse absent; both must approve. Can arrange a joint follow-up.
same_day_close_condition: Only if spouse joins and both understand design, scope and investment; otherwise agree a specific joint follow-up without pressuring one spouse.

triggers.line: My spouse will want a say in how this looks.
I need to think about it.
I cannot decide for both of us today.

scenarios.title: The hot afternoon patio
scenarios.priority: Use the west-facing patio after work.
scenarios.constraint: Spouse dislikes designs that block too much indoor light.
scenarios.opening: This patio gets too hot to use in the afternoon.

scenarios.title: Shade over the dining table
scenarios.priority: Keep the outdoor dining table shaded.
scenarios.constraint: Existing doors and fascia need a site review; no engineering promises.
scenarios.opening: We are thinking about a cover over this part of the patio.

scenarios.title: A larger outdoor room
scenarios.priority: Create room for dining and a lounge area.
scenarios.constraint: Spouse travels this week and needs a scheduled joint review.
scenarios.opening: We have talked about making this into more of an outdoor room.
